thread:
alex: heads-up: seeing apiserver 503 spikes in us-west1-gpu this morning, coincides with a flurry of etcd leader elections and controller-manager restarts. graphs show 5xxs from nodes ~03:10->03:25 UTC.

deploy-bot: @channel rollout/redwood-infra/gpu-scaler v2.3 started by mira at 2026-03-08T03:08:52Z (canary first) :rocket:

mira: did the rollout touch the node-lifecycle or cloud-provider bits? canary shows PVC attach ops + device-plugin restarts.

sam: logs from apiserver around 03:12: 
```
E0308 03:12:14.123 request-bodies.go:352] apiserver error: 503 Service Unavailable - timeout waiting for etcd response
E0308 03:12:17.442 controller-manager: W0308 03:12:17 controller-runtime/manager.go:xxx] controller failed sync: failed to reconcile node gpu-01: Post "https://10.4.1.12:2379/v3/kv/txn": context deadline exceeded
```

lee: on the etcd side: 
```
etcd1: raft: election timeout reached, starting campaign at term 42
etcd2: rafthttp: failed to send to peer 10.4.1.12 (unreachable)
```

mira: hmm, control plane pods are healthy by k8s status probe but RPCs are timing out. could be networking (pkt loss) or disk i/o on etcd hosts.

sam: I grabbed tcpdump between apiserver and etcd: lots of retransmits and dup acks. sample: `tcp retransmission from 10.4.2.15:443 -> 10.4.1.12:2379` around same window.

lee: saw a cloud maintenance event in us-west1 around 03:05 (BGP flaps reported). ops-bot, can you paste provider advisory?

ops-bot: cloud-provider: Scheduled network maintenance in region us-west1, windows 2026-03-08T02:50Z-03:20Z. Some control-plane network paths may have experienced brief packet loss. Incident ID CP-4921.

alex: ok that aligns. question: why did controller-manager restart and fail to provision GPUs during this window? logs show `failed to bind pci device: resource temporarily unavailable` and many timeouts talking to API server.

mira: the GPU device-plugin sidecars restarted during the canary which triggered a short reconciliation storm. with apiserver RPCs degraded, controller got backlog and OOMish pressure (lots of queued work).

sam: mitigation timeline I suggest: 1) pause rollout (done) 2) increase etcd election timeout from 1000ms -> 3000ms temporarily 3) add a control-plane replica in us-west2 and shift provisioning to us-west2 for current jobs 4) disable NIC GRO/GSO/TSO on etcd/apiserver hosts as test (we've seen cloud NIC offload issues cause retransmits).

lee: note on cost: spinning an extra control-plane replica + cross-region failover will add ~2x control-plane VM cost for the short window. if we move GPU jobs to us-west2 we might pay egress + double-hosting during migration. we should estimate before flip.

alex: agreed. cost ok for now if it prevents rollout rollback. mira, can you trigger the us-west2 canary and set annotation `provisioning.k8s.redwood/region-prefer=us-west2` for the job queue? sam, can you apply the temporary etcd election timeout change and disable offloads on the three etcd hosts?

mira: will do the canary. adding annotation now and holding new job submissions in us-west1. :white_check_mark:

sam: applying etcd election timeout bump and NIC offload toggles now: `kubectl -n kube-system patch cm etcd-config --patch '{"data":{"election-timeout":"3000"}}'` then `ssh etcd1 sudo ethtool -K eth0 tso off gso off gro off` (rolling).

ops-bot: alert: new control-plane replica provisioning started in us-west2 (task CP-PR-777). Estimated 12m.

lee: also recommend we add a short-term autoscaling buffer for controller-manager (cpu/mem request bump) during reconciliation storms so it doesn't OOM/CrashLoop. smaller change than full rollback.

alex: good call. I'll patch deployment to +50% requests for controller-manager and apiserver proxies.

mira: after the canary flip, GPU provisioning in us-west2 succeeded for 6 nodes, no 503s. monitoring shows apiserver 5xxs dropping back to baseline.

sam: etcd leader elections reduced after NIC offload toggles and election timeout bump. keeping changes for 2 hours, then we'll revert one-by-one to confirm root cause.

lee: action items summary: 
- mira: pause us-west1 rollouts and complete us-west2 canary (done)
- sam: apply etcd election timeout & NIC offload changes (in progress)
- alex: bump controller-manager/apiserver requests (in progress)
- lee: cost estimate + TL;DR for infra leadership about temporary extra control-plane replica (ETA 20m)

alex: thanks team. follow-up postmortem if we confirm cloud network maintenance + NIC offload interaction as root cause. feel free to add notes here. :spiral_note_pad:
